svg.title: Baseline J01-J04: database schema (generated by Hibernate into the H2 file)

g.text: Baseline J01-J04: database schema (generated by Hibernate into the H2 file)
J02 replaces it in one transaction,
so every import swaps the whole
NULL because the JSON has no date.
price is NULL when the source has
no usable amount. It is never 0.
Offer text is stored per language
and is not split into a unit price.
product_code is the primary key, so a
product appears at most once per list
and a repeat add increases quantity.
There is no foreign key to PRODUCT:
list rows are kept even if the product
is missing from a newer catalogue.
No price is copied into the list.
